dbe_source.recommendation: For > 0 the solution is OUTSIDE the roots. For < 0 the solution is BETWEEN the roots. The sign of the inequality decides which.

lesson.concept: For > 0 the solution is OUTSIDE the roots. For < 0 the solution is BETWEEN the roots. The sign of the inequality decides which.
lesson.why: This is one of the highest-frequency errors DBE reported for this section.

work: The coefficient of x^2 is positive, so the parabola opens up
We want y < 0, which is the part below the x-axis
That is between the roots: -2 < x < 2
Not x < -2 or x > 2. That would be the > 0 case.

probe.hint: See the example for the pattern.

learner_message: The interval is on the wrong side of the roots. For > 0 the answer is outside; for < 0 it is between them.
